name: io.github.dirkjanfaber/mcp-server-petkit
title: PetKit
description: Unofficial MCP server for PetKit smart feeders: status, feeding history and schedule control.

environmentVariables.name: PETKIT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email address of your PetKit account

environmentVariables.name: PETKIT_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Region name exactly as shown in the PetKit app (e.g. "Netherlands", "United States")

environmentVariables.name: PETKIT_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone (e.g. "Europe/Amsterdam"); defaults to the host's timezone
